sentence: ___ — you'll get there early and find the best seats.
correct: The early bird catches the worm

sentence: By recycling old furniture, we ___: we save money and help the planet.

explanation: <Kill two birds with one stone> significa lograr dos cosas con una sola acción.

sentence: I lost my wallet, but I found a better one — ___.

explanation: <Every cloud has a silver lining> significa que hay algo bueno en cada situación mala.

sentence: Keep practicing the piano — ___.

sentence: These problems are just ___ — there's much more to fix.

sentence: The small café looked boring, but the food was amazing — ___.

explanation: <Don't judge a book by its cover> significa no juzgar por las apariencias.

sentence: She ___ to finish her essay before the deadline.

sentence: Losing my job was ___ — I found a much better one.

sentence: My sister and I don't always ___ about politics.

sentence: He'll clean his room ___.

sentence: I'm just ___ — it was a joke!

sentence: Working from home gives me ___: freedom and comfort.

sentence: His angry comments only ___.

sentence: Taking five classes at once was ___.
correct: biting off more than I could chew
explanation: <Bite off more than you can chew> significa intentar hacer más de lo que puedes manejar.

sentence: ___ this weekend — you deserve a rest.
